Parrots for Newcastle upon Tyne homes

Organising enquiries and proposed handover. Start with the practical questions, then enquire about the individual bird.

Organising enquiries and proposed handover

If you are enquiring from Newcastle upon Tyne, establish which bird is being discussed before making any journey. Request current details and ask what viewing arrangements, if any, can be agreed.

Resolve the terms clearly

Ask about the price, what is included and any proposed deposit or other terms. Keep a copy of agreed information. Clarify which records and care details will accompany the bird so that important questions do not wait until the day of handover.

Prepare suitable transport arrangements

Discuss the proposed handover and appropriate travel equipment with the relevant keeper and, where needed, an avian professional. Availability and transport arrangements must be confirmed for the individual enquiry. Include Newcastle upon Tyne and any practical travel limitations in your message.

Research the groups before enquiring

Use the species collection to compare all eight groups, from African Grey Parrots and macaws to conures and small psittacines. Each profile covers diet, lifespan, personality, accommodation and vocalisation. The UK buying enquiry hub explains what to ask about an actual bird.

Work through the buying checklist and price and lifetime cost guidance before agreeing to a purchase. Current availability and any proposed arrangements must be confirmed directly.
